The subject features prominent cheek pads (flanges), dark skin on the face, and long, shaggy reddish-brown fur covering the body and head. The orangutan's hands are clasped together near the chin/mouth area. A faint, white, web-like structure (possibly a spiderweb or digital artifact) is visible in the lower-left foreground.
